screens.title: 1 · The web page opens on the agent
screens.why: A computer's first screen says Lunna is asked, not filled in, and the phone beside it proves it by answering.

pins.label: Headline
pins.text: "Diga o que precisa. O dia se arruma." replaces "Seu dia, no lugar.": the agent is the promise, the timeline is how it keeps it. The pitch names the plan you approve and the deliveries.

pins.label: Three chapters = the app's tabs
pins.text: Peça, Tempo, Entregas, one under the other. The chosen one is filled (AppColors.fill) and says its line; the others are a name to tap. Peça is the agent's crescent (AppIcons.agent) in accent; no sparkles.

pins.label: Experimente pedir
pins.text: Two example asks as pills (arrow-up icon, as the send button). A tap opens the agent in the phone and sends it, as if typed there. The first one is asked on load.

pins.label: The phone is the app
pins.text: The real AgentSheet over Tempo, on a scripted DemoAgentRepository: thinking dots, the reply, the PlanCard. Nothing reaches a server.

pins.label: Aplicar works
pins.text: Applying writes the plan on the demo day, and closing the sheet shows it on Tempo; the chapter beside it follows to Tempo.

screens.title: 2 · Entregas, chosen beside the phone
screens.why: The deliveries tab, which the old page never showed, gets a chapter of its own and the phone switches to it.

pins.label: Chapter Entregas
pins.text: Stack icon (AppIcons.artifacts), as on the tab. Its line: what you owe, with deadline and value; the month's goal; the hours the queue needs against the agenda's free ones.

pins.label: Real ArtifactsPage
pins.text: The goal (Faturamento · outubro), the schedule line and the Fila, from a DemoArtifactsRepository seeded as an astrologer's month.

pins.label: Bar is live, both ways
pins.text: Tapping Tempo or Entregas in the phone moves the choice beside it (one DemoController). Menu stays drawn and inert.

pins.label: + follows the tab
pins.text: On Entregas the FAB opens the new-delivery sheet, as in the app; on Tempo it sits beside the ask bar (AskDock).

screens.title: 3 · Under the first screen
screens.why: The rest of the app in three short columns, then the day said in four lines.

pins.label: Também no app
pins.text: Rotinas, Lembretes and Voz (new). Tempo left this row: it is a chapter now.

pins.label: No dia a dia
pins.text: Four lines, opening with asking ("Peça, e veja o plano antes de aplicar") and closing with a delivery ("Feche uma entrega e veja a meta andar").

pins.label: Privacy and footer
pins.text: Unchanged: what PostHog records, said before anyone signs in.

screens.title: 4 · On a phone: no phone in the page
screens.why: The screen already is a phone; a drawn one would be a thumbnail. Each chapter shows its piece of the app instead.

pins.label: Same headline
pins.text: 40 px instead of 56; the pitch follows.

pins.label: Peça, first
pins.text: The first ask as the sheet draws it, the reply and the real PlanCard. Aplicar here only marks it applied: there is no day to change before signing in.

screens.title: 5 · On a phone: Entregas
screens.why: Tempo is said in words (a phone already knows a day); Entregas gets its goal and the next two deliveries.

pins.label: Chapter Entregas
pins.text: Accent stack icon, the same line as on the web.

pins.label: GoalCard + ArtifactRow
pins.text: The app's own widgets from packages/artifacts, read-only here, from the same demo data as the wide page's phone.
